tools.notes: Write-capable MCP route that builds or refreshes the lexical wiki/docs search index for a configured workspace repository — the explicit index-builder companion to workspace_search_repo. Pass reindex:true for a full rebuild. Resolves the repository through configured aliases and accepts no caller-supplied filesystem root. CLI fallback: `npm run wiki -- build-search-index`.
use_when: An operator explicitly refreshes the configured repository's lexical search cache.
do_not_use_when: Ordinary wiki or docs retrieval, which needs no rebuild first, or any canonical-data mutation.
authoritative_for: lexical search-index build metadata

recommended_first_call.operation: workspace_build_search_index

tools.notes: Runs one literal repository-relative test file with its prepared runtime runner against the server-authenticated source and reports the native process outcome with no proof credit. Every response is at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes; stdout and stderr are clipped tails, and the complete settled result is retained for this route's own read and continue calls; retry reruns a refused request.
use_when: An authenticated orchestrator, worker or reviewer needs the native outcome of one repository test file (optionally one native selector) in its prepared runtime environment; an orchestrator names source {kind:current_main} or {kind:exact_sha,value}.
A failing run should be compared once with the same request on the source parent that an owned checkout already holds (compare_parent:true).
An earlier answer named omitted output or a retained view: copy its returned read or continue call exactly; each read names the selection that follows it, and reads never execute.
A refusal returned a retry call (for example a worker's source cleared, or an orchestrator's source named): invoke that exact call to run the corrected request as a new execution.
do_not_use_when: The question is whether saved proofs hold; use verify_proof, which owns proof credit.
The task needs a command, arguments, environment variables, a root, a glob, a directory or another session's source; none is an input.
A worker or reviewer wants to name a source or an exact commit; their launcher-bound source is implicit.
authoritative_for: the native outcome of one ordinary test-file run in a prepared runtime against an authenticated source, with at most one parent comparison, and the retained settled result

recommended_first_call.operation: run one repository test file

tools.notes: Read compact canonical context, then one semantic selection from its returned reference. A WK subject's context facts carry the advisory terminal_review_designation; a findings unit's context facts and each inventory:"slices" member carry its effective review_purpose when one exists. Both are read-only observations of the saved record that grant or withhold no dispatch, admission, integration or handoff decision.
use_when: Read compact canonical context, then one semantic selection from its returned reference.
do_not_use_when: The request needs an ungranted role, caller-selected repository or another task.
authoritative_for: Read compact canonical context, then one semantic selection from its returned reference.

recommended_first_call.operation: Read compact canonical context, then one semantic selection from its returned reference.
